  CITY OF SANTA MONICA

  CITY COUNCIL MINUTES

  DECEMBER 6, 2022

  A special meeting of the Santa Monica City Council was called to order by Mayor Himmelrich at 6:03 p.m.,
  on Tuesday, December 6, 2022, at City Council Chambers, 1685 Main Street, Santa Monica, CA.

  Also Present:  City Manager David White
  City Attorney Douglas Sloan
  City Clerk Denise Anderson-Warren

  members present. Mayor Pro Tem McCowan led the assemblage in the

  CITY COUNCIL  4.F. Administration of Oath of Office to New Santa Monica City
  Councilmembers, was presented.

  City Clerk Anderson-Warren administered the oath of office to newly
  elected Councilmembers Caroline Torosis, Jesse Zwick and Lana Negrete.

  CONVENING OF THE  4.G  Convening of new City Council, was presented.
  NEW CITY COUNCIL
  AND ELECTION OF  • Roll Call
  MAYOR AND MAYOR
  PRO TEMPORE  PRESENT: Councilmembers de la Torre, Brock, Zwick, Negrete, Davis,
  Parra, and Torosis

  • Election of Mayor for the ensuing two years

  The City Clerk opened the floor for nominations for electing of Mayor for
  the ensuing two years.

  Motion by Councilmember Brock, seconded by Councilmember Negrete, to
  combine the election of Mayor and Mayor Pro Tem. The motion was
  approved by the following vote:

  AYES:  Councilmembers Parra, Davis, Negrete, Torosis, Zwick, Brock,
  de la Torre
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT: None

  Questions ask and answered of staff included: whether the previous motion
  was permissive; whether Councilmember Davis served as Mayor
  previously; and can previouslymade motions be voted on again.

  Discussion included concerns that the current selection process creates
  divisiveness; and the possibility of directing staff to come back with a
  rotating Mayor process that might create more unity.

  Motion by Councilmember Parra, seconded by Councilmember de la Torre,
  to appoint Councilmember Brock as Mayor for the first year and
  Councilmember de la Torre as Mayor for the second year, and
  Councilmember Negrete as Mayor Pro Tem for both years.

  Substitute motion by Councilmember Torosis, seconded by Councilmember
  Davis, to appoint Councilmember Davis as Mayor and Councilmember
  Negrete as Mayor Pro Tem for the first year and then switch seats for the
  second year with Councilmember Negrete as Mayor and Councilmember
  Davis as Mayor Pro Tem.

  The motion failed by the following vote:

  Substitute motion by Councilmember Torosis, seconded by Councilmember

  Negrete as Mayor Pro Tem the first year, and Councilmember Negrete as
  Mayor and Councilmember Brock as Mayor Pro Tem the second year.

  The motion failed by the following vote:

  AYES:  Councilmembers Torosis, Zwick, Davis
  NOES:  Councilmembers de la Torre, Brock, Negrete, Parra
  ABSENT: None

  Substitute motion by Councilmember Torosis, seconded by Councilmember
  Davis, to appoint Councilmember Davis as Mayor for the first year,
  Councilmember Brock as Mayor for the second year with Councilmember
  Negrete serving as Mayor Pro Tem for both years. The motion was approved
  by the following vote:

  AYES:  Councilmembers Davis, Negrete, Zwick, Torosis
  NOES:  Councilmembers Parra, Brock, de la Torre
  ABSENT: None
